name: base_utils
description: Manages common host utilities, including an optional /etc/motd and configurable utility package installation, along with related custom facts, functions, and Bolt automation.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Prepares and deploys a Python application stack, including Python dependencies, application and database content, service configuration, systemd management, and monitoring-related behavior.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Installs and configures HAProxy with backend definitions, health checks, TLS and statistics settings, optional discovery, service management, and firewall integration.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Configures PostgreSQL repositories, installs the selected PostgreSQL version and packages, and manages the database service lifecycle.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Installs and configures Redis with authentication, resource limits, and cluster-related settings, using PuppetDB queries to discover peer information.
